name: Raven Feature Center
summary: The showcase of RavenRS: every public component and every feature of the application framework, one small demonstration each, with a tour to try them and the page each component points to in recursos.json.
when_to_use: To see a component or a framework feature working before using it.
After adding or changing a component: give it a page with every public feature (scripts/feature-center-coverage.py checks it).
To open one page on its own, embedded, in a theme or a language, for a screenshot or a film.

commands.does: Opens the center: sign in as ana, bia or caio (password raven-demo) and go through the navigation. Closing the window keeps it beside the clock.

commands.command: raven-feature-center --modo vitrine | componentes | playground [--pagina <Nome>] [--incorporado] [--tema claro|escuro] [--idioma en|pt]
commands.does: Opens one way of the center, as the site does: the showcase, only the components, the playground, a page from the start.
Opens the counter window on its own.
Builds every way the center opens with no window; exit code 0 when each one draws.

limits: The data of the demonstrations is made up and lives in memory or in a local SQLite file.
The web build is made with scripts/build-web.sh raven-feature-center.
